goal: ga pins rlo-sdk 8131a2b (0.8.1) instead of 3d2e7d0 (0.7.0), so every guard that ga generates (upgrade-remote included) installs an rlo with K13's deadlock fix and K14's bounded window.

scope.text: Move every rlo-sdk pin in ga-SDK (pyproject and any generated install script / PIN constant that ga writes) from 3d2e7d0 to 8131a2b. Nothing else changes; GR's ga.rlo module keeps its owner (if a pin lives in GR's files, say so in the report instead of editing it).

done_when.text: An empty venv installs ga-sdk at your commit with rlo-sdk 0.8.1 (pip list) and pip check is clean; the full ga suite passes in a fresh clone.

A guard generated by `ga rlo upgrade-remote` (or the generator it calls) pins 8131a2b; a test asserts the generated PIN equals the package pin, and a mutation that leaves 3d2e7d0 in the generator is killed.
